sections.title: Section 1: Westley Public Librarymembership Application Form
sections.html:
application form

(noun). đơn xin

We have received application forms from more than 3 000 students.

identification

(noun). sự nhận ra, sự nhận diện, sự nhận dạng

Each product has a number for identification.

prove

(verb). chứng minh, chứng tỏ

She continued to prove her points

license

(noun). bằng cấp

You have to have a driving license

mystery

(noun). điều huyền bí; điều bí ẩn

The house had some great mysteries.

detective

(noun). cảnh sát điều tra, thám tử

Sherlock Holmes was a detective

murder

(noun). tội phạm giết người

He committed a murder

science fiction

(noun). khoa học viễn tưởng

I love watching science fiction film

weird

(adjective). kỳ lạ

She's got some weird ideas.

deposit

(noun). tiền đặt cọc

They normally ask you to pay $100 as a deposit.

returnable

(adjective). có thể trả lại

A returnable deposit is paid

sections.title: Section 2: Component Parts
sections.html:
transfusion

(noun). sự truyền máu

She needed a blood transfusion.

vital

(adjective). quan trọng; trọng yếu

The vitamins are vital for health

fraction

(noun). phần nhỏ

Only a small fraction of a cake will be eaten

virtually

(adverb). hầu như, gần như

They are virtually the same

vulnerability

(noun). tính dễ bị thương tổn, tính dễ bị tấn công, tính dễ bị công kích

He is aware of the vulnerability of the balloon

cell

(noun). tế bào

This is the cell structure of people

victim

(noun). nạn nhân

She was the victim

surgery

(noun). cuộc phẫu thuật

He needs surgery on his left knee.

transplant

(noun). cấy ghép

He experienced the hair transplant

treatment

(noun). sự chữa trị

The patient needs the treatment from the doctor

critically

(adverb). trầm trọng

Covid-19 will critically affect a person's health

premature

(adjective). sớm; non

The baby was four weeks premature.

countless

(adjective). vô số

There are countless birds on the sky

component

(noun). bộ phận thành phần

Nitrogen is the main component of air.

(verb). liên tưởng

Most people associate this brand with good quality.

function

(noun). chức năng

The function of the heart is to pump blood through the body.

immune system

(noun). hệ miễn dịch

Your immune system protects you from illness

patient

(noun). bệnh nhân

The patient is lying on the bed

defense

(noun). khả năng phòng thủ, sự phòng thủ

The vaccine will strengthen the body’s defenses against Covid 19

platelet

(noun). tiểu cầu (tiểu huyết cầu)

This is a picture of a platelet

(adjective). rất quan trọng

It is crucial for fat people to take physical exercise if they want to lose weights

clot

(verb). làm đông, làm đóng cục

My hair was all clotted

suffer (from)

(verb). chịu đựng

She's been suffering from cancer for two years.

plasma

(noun). huyết tương

Plasma is the yellow liquid

administer

(verb). quản lý

Steve Jobs used to administer Apple Inc.

outpatient

(noun). bệnh nhân ngoại trú

They are the outpatient bebcause they do not have to stay at the hospital overnight

come along

(verb). đến, tới, nhập cuộc

She invited me: "Why don't you come along?"

calm

(verb). làm ai đó dịu xuống, bình tĩnh lại

I found out that meditation can calm me.

donate

(verb). hiến, quyên góp

She is donating blood

donor

(noun). người hiến tặng

He is a blood donor

screen

(verb). sàng lọc

The hospital is screening their patients so that they can know whether or not their patients have Covid-19 or not

(noun). phòng thí nghiệm

(verb). hình dung, tưởng tượng

demand

(noun). sự đòi, sự yêu cầu

(verb). đặt trước

(adjective). dễ hiểu, không lòng vòng

(verb). xóa đi, bỏ đi

stress

(verb). bị làm cho căng thẳng

She is stressed about her daily tasks

assignment

(noun). việc được phân công, bài tập

ban

(verb). cấm

(noun). năm học

They started a new academic year

remind

(verb). nhắc nhở

Parents should remind their kids to brush their teeth everyday

colleague

(noun). đồng nghiệp

We have been friends and colleagues for more than 20 years.

in charge of

(adjective). chịu trách nhiệm tiếp quản

I'm in charge of organizing the project.

automatically

(adverb). một cách tự động

The system switches off automatically.

password

(noun). mật khẩu

A password is necessary if you want to use my laptop

biology

(noun). môn sinh học

In biology, people can study about living animals

upset

(adjective). không vui, giận dữ

She is very upset

print

(verb). in ra

I'm waiting for a document to print

queue

(noun). hàng chờ

There was a long queue for tickets at the theater

tray

(noun). cái khay

It's an an empty tray

cost

(verb). tốn tiền của ai

It costs them $8.16 to buy a ticket

training

(noun). buổi huấn luyện, quá trình huấn luyện

They are having a training

introductory

(adjective). mang tính mở đầu

The introductory chapter of a book usually includes the message of the author

intermediate

(adjective). trung cấp

I am learning an intermediate German course

advanced

(adjective). nâng cao

She is an advanced student of English

stick with

(verb). dính với

She always sticks with music and paintings

tough

(adjective). khó khăn

It is a tough competition

part time job

(noun). việc bán thời gian

I apply for a part time job at The Coffee House

sections.html:
bring up

(verb). nuôi dưỡng, nuôi dạy

He was brought up by his aunt.

revolutionize

(verb). cách mạng hoá

(noun). đường sắt cao tốc

Bullet train is a type of train that runs faster than traditional train.

(verb). công nhận

inspiration

(noun). sự truyền cảm hứng

(noun). danh tiếng

The company enjoys an international reputation for quality of design.

punctuality

(noun). sự đúng giờ

He cares about punctuality.

unsurpassed

(adjective). vượt trội

His knowledge of the subject is unsurpassed.

inception

(noun). sự khởi đầu

The company has grown since its inception in 2007.

deliberate

(adjective). cố ý

We made a deliberate decision not to live together

misadventure

(noun). sai lầm

Princess Diana died by misadventure

record

(noun). kỷ lục

She holds the world record for the 100-meter run

destination

(noun). điểm đến

We arrived at our destination

statistic

(noun). số liệu, thống kê

They are checking the statistics about the customers

authority

(noun). người có quyền, nhà đương cục

She's an authority

category

(noun). hạng, loại

There are many categories in the car market

roughly

(adverb). đại khái; khoảng chừng

Pi is roughly 3.14

(adjective). được tập trung hóa

Your data should be centralised so that managing will be easier

locomotive

(noun). động cơ tàu hỏa

This is a steam locomotive

coach

(noun). toa tàu

These coaches are colorful

flimsy

(adjective). mỏng manh

Such flimsy pants

undulation

(noun). sự nhấp nhô, gợn sóng

(verb). tăng tốc

It has to accelerate to finish the race

function

(noun). chức năng

The function of the heart is to pump blood through the body.

brake

(noun). thắng, phanh

This is a brake of a bicycle

revolve

(verb). quay tròn

The earth revolves around the sun

motor

(noun). mô tơ

Our washing machine needs a new motor

rotate

(verb). quay

This picture means that you have to rotate your phone

magnetic induction

(noun). sự cảm ứng từ

Magnetic induction is used in a card reader

virtue

(noun). tính hiệu quả, công dụng

(verb). trải qua

She is undergoing a cancer treatment

(adjective). rất tốt, rất đáng kể

They were making a tremendous amount of noise last night.

(noun). chất bán dẫn

Semiconductors are used for making chips
